findings.title: Union-class `new` now takes dependently-typed args the doc calls unsupported
findings.body: Measured: with this hunk the program below prints `ann`; main panics (`must be Monomorphized`) and jBallerina rejects it (cannot infer the typedesc). subset10.md's Matching jBallerina section still lists dependently-typed calls as unsupported under a union of classes. Is accepting them intended (drop that bullet, note the jBallerina difference), or should they be rejected?

outputs.jBallerina: ERROR [u1.bal:(26:24,26:46)] cannot infer the 'typedesc' argument for parameter 't'

findings.title: 2f7ac76f4 reworks 6ae4744c6's named-type code; squash it
findings.body: Read: 2f7ac76f4 renames helpers 6ae4744c6 adds (`resolveActionOrExpressionWithNamedTypes`, `UntypedFunctionSignature.NamedTypes`), moves `Param.NamedTypes` onto the signature and makes `common.NamedTypes` skip non-type refs. AGENTS.md wants such corrections as fixups, so squash it into 6ae4744c6.

findings.title: Head fixes #1496, #1497 and #1498 but the body doesn't close them
findings.body: Measured: the repro tests from all three issues pass at bfe316b40 and fail at #1434's head (rest and default drop `@mark`, the constructor case panics). Add `Fixes #1496`, `Fixes #1497` and `Fixes #1498`, or say why they stay open.

findings.title: PR body doesn't describe bfe316b40's fix
findings.body: Measured: a default that calls a dependently-typed function declared later (`int val = inferred(0)` before `inferred`) fails on main with `INTERNAL_ERROR: function parameter type not found` and works at bfe316b40. Describe it like the separate 6c16fabfb fix.

findings.title: PR body skips the template's Purpose, Approach and Checklist sections
findings.body: Read: the body uses Summary/Problem/How it's fixed/Changes headings instead of `.github/pull_request_template.md`'s `## Purpose` (with `Fixes #N` or a reason), `## Approach` and the checklist. Map the existing text onto those sections.
